about: Synthetic draft and final pairs for her-share.py, each with the counts it must report. Invented text only; no writer's real drafts. `files` adds other files to the piece folder (an edit report, for the writer-first path). Kept apart from tell-cases.json so a hook's cases arrive with its own change.
